note:
Per-fixture allowlist of EXPECTED layout-diff check failures (lib/expected-failures.mjs). A listed failure does not make layout-diff/run.mjs exit 2 and does not fail the gate. The expiry is enforced: when a listed check passes, run.mjs exits 2 and the gate fails with 'allowlist entry expired' until the entry is removed. Adding an entry needs a reason with evidence and an expiry condition; it never hides an input-parity failure that invalidates attribution without saying so (attribution_valid stays false and Chrome-referenced verdicts keep their caveat). Removed in port step 05 (html_normalize deleted, entries expired): receipt normalize_wrappers_located, normalize_dom_roundtrip and dom_key_alignment (the

hoist), oss-postmark-receipt normalize_dom_roundtrip (the HTML re-parse of html_normalize's serialized output). Removed in port step 08 (every document parsed as HTML, entries expired as their expiry condition said): oss-postmark-receipt source_dom_keys_vs_chromium and dom_key_alignment (blitz-html's XML parse of the XHTML-doctype source had table>tr, no implied tbody).
